findings.title: Three cross-references render as literal label text
findings.cause: Doubled backslash before ref produces a line break instead of a reference.
findings.impact: Readers cannot follow the intended protocol and release-provenance references.
findings.required_change: Use single-backslash reference commands and reject doubled-backslash ref strings or their rendered literals during verification.

findings.title: PDF reproduction commands lose executable spaces
findings.cause: Shell commands are passed through path formatting, which discards spaces.
findings.impact: Commands copied or transcribed from the manuscript do not execute as instructed. The nested README has correct commands.
findings.required_change: Render commands with a space-preserving code/verbatim treatment and inspect both the page and extracted text.

findings.title: Figure 4 annotations obscure high-rent markers
findings.cause: Both zero-receipt notes occupy axes coordinates containing plotted observations.
findings.impact: The note text and several observations overlap, especially in the winner panel.
findings.required_change: Move the notes into subtitles, margins or the caption and re-render the figure and PDF.

findings.title: Portable verifier does not validate the new central ledgers
findings.observed: The verifier still returns pass after three newly added data values are independently replaced with 999999 in an isolated copied package.
findings.impact: A portable pass can coexist with stale or corrupted END, certificate and opportunity data. The unchanged frozen values themselves pass this review's independent checks.
findings.required_change: Verify record-level END partitioning, certificate summary/result consistency, 80-cell opportunity reaggregation, source digests and native table agreement.

packaging_integration_notes.scope: Coordinator is updating live packaging; this is not an assertion about the later final ZIP.
packaging_integration_notes.required_final_check: Include and hash the nested ZIP, fail on missing required inputs, and run verification from the exact final extraction.
